title: AI-Protocol V2 Context Management Policy
description: Context window management strategies for V2 provider manifests. Defines sliding window, summarization triggers, token budgets, and overflow handling. Provider-agnostic abstractions for managing limited context windows across varying provider capabilities.

strategy.description: Primary context management strategy: sliding_window (drop oldest messages), summarize (compress old context), truncate_oldest (hard cut), token_budget (allocate per role), adaptive (auto-select based on context)

max_context_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to use from the provider's context window (may be less than model max)

reserve_for_output.description: Tokens reserved for model output generation

system_message_budget.description: Maximum tokens for system messages (0 = unlimited within context)

tool_budget.description: Maximum tokens for tool definitions and results

window_size.description: Number of recent message pairs to keep

preserve_system.description: Always keep system messages regardless of window position

preserve_tool_context.description: Keep tool call/result pairs together (never split mid-tool-use)

anchor_messages.description: Number of initial messages to always preserve (after system)

enabled.description: Enable automatic summarization of old context

trigger_threshold.description: Context fill ratio that triggers summarization (0.8 = 80% full)

summary_max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens for the summary message

summary_model.description: Model to use for summarization (if different from main model, e.g. a faster model)

preserve_recent.description: Number of recent message pairs to preserve unsummarized

overflow_handling.description: What to do when context still exceeds limits after policy application

action.description: Action when context exceeds budget after policy application

error_code.description: Standard error code for context overflow (request_too_large)

supports_context_caching.description: Provider supports context caching for repeated prefixes (Gemini, Anthropic)

supports_compaction_api.description: Provider has a native context compaction API (Anthropic)
